_comment: Hono's generated test target builds with zero rustc errors (`test_compile_errors`, exact pin via scripts/check_library_gate.py compile-pin), so its tests run and are ratcheted like es-toolkit's (runtime-ratchet): `runtime_passed` is the floor and `runtime_known_failures` the only tests allowed to fail. The six E0308 in src/router_test_2.rs that used to keep the target from building went away when nested union arms started flattening (#354). The 21 `cors` failures that surfaced then were fixed in the same PR (a call through a union of callables of different arity passes every argument; `typeof f === 'function'` on an erased value is variadic). The pinned failures are pre-existing defects that were never run before: `mount` routing (3), pretty-json's indent argument (3), RegExpRouter param capture (4).
